preConditions.sqlCheck: SELECT CASE WHEN COUNT(*) > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END FROM pg_constraint con JOIN pg_class rel ON rel.oid = con.conrelid JOIN pg_namespace nsp ON nsp.oid = rel.relnamespace JOIN pg_class frel ON frel.oid = con.confrelid WHERE con.contype = 'f' AND nsp.nspname = 'public' AND frel.relname = 'tenant_organization' AND pg_get_constraintdef(con.oid) LIKE '%(tenant_id)%' AND pg_get_constraintdef(con.oid) NOT LIKE '%ON UPDATE CASCADE%'

changeSet.sql: DO $$ DECLARE r record; BEGIN FOR r IN SELECT con.conname AS conname, rel.relname AS relname, pg_get_constraintdef(con.oid) AS def FROM pg_constraint con JOIN pg_class rel ON rel.oid = con.conrelid JOIN pg_namespace nsp ON nsp.oid = rel.relnamespace JOIN pg_class frel ON frel.oid = con.confrelid WHERE con.contype = 'f' AND nsp.nspname = 'public' AND frel.relname = 'tenant_organization' AND pg_get_constraintdef(con.oid) LIKE '%(tenant_id)%' AND pg_get_constraintdef(con.oid) NOT LIKE '%ON UPDATE CASCADE%' LOOP EXECUTE format('ALTER TABLE public.%I DROP CONSTRAINT %I', r.relname, r.conname); EXECUTE format( 'ALTER TABLE public.%I ADD CONSTRAINT %I %s', r.relname, r.conname, replace(r.def, 'ON DELETE CASCADE', 'ON UPDATE CASCADE ON DELETE CASCADE') ); END LOOP; END $$;
